A.text: Two finite sets have m and n elements respectively. The total number of subsets of first set is 24 more than the total number of subsets of the second set. The value of 2m + n is
A.sol_text:
Answer : (3)
Solution:
Let A and B be sets
n(A) = m and n(B) = n
n(P(A)) = 2^m, n(P(B)) = 2^n
n(P(A)) − n(P(B)) = 24
⇒ 2^m − 2^n = 24
⇒ 2^n (2^(m−n) − 1) = 2^3 × 3
n = 3, 2^(m−n) − 1 = 3
⇒ n = 3 and m = 5

B.text: If α, β, γ be the roots of the equation x³ - 3x² - x + 2 = 0 and P(x) is another cubic polynomial with leading coefficient unity whose roots are βγ - α², γα - β² and αβ - γ². Then the value of P(2) is equal to
B.sol_text:
Let y = βγ - α² = (αβγ)/α - α² = -(2/x) - x²
⇒ x³ + xy + 2 = 0 ...(i)
Given x³ - 3x² - x + 2 = 0 ...(ii)
From (i) and (ii)
3x² + x(y + 1) = 0
⇒ x = -(y + 1)/3
Substituting the value of x in (ii) we get
-((y + 1)/3)³ - 3((y + 1)/3)² + ((y + 1)/3) + 2 = 0
⇒ -[y² + 3y² + 3y + 1] - 9[y² + 2y + 1] + 9[y + 1] + 54 = 0
⇒ y + 12y² + 12y - 53 = 0

B.subject: Mathematics
B.text: The distance of the point (1, 2) from the line x + y + 5 = 0 measured along the line parallel to 3x − y = 7 is equal to √λ , where λ is
B.sol_text:
Given line is 3x − y = 7
⇒ y = 3x − 7 ...(i)
whose slope = 3 = tanθ
∴ cos θ = −1/√10 , sin θ = 3/√10
∴ The equation of the line passing through (1, 2) and parallel to y = 3x − 7 is
(x − 1)/cos θ = (y − 2)/sin θ = r where r is the required distance
⇒ x = 1 + r cos θ
y = 2 + r sin θ
∴ The point (1 + r cos θ, 2 + r sin θ) will lie on the line x + y + 5 = 0
⇒ 1 + r cos θ + 2 + r sin θ + 5 = 0
⇒ r(−1/√10 + 3/√10) + 8 = 0
⇒ r = (−8√10)/4 = −2√10
But distance cannot be negative
∴ Required distance = 2√10 units
B.nvt_note: Give your answer correct to two decimal places.
